note: Minutes of a change of station, as assumed in model/nordest.py (CHANGE_METRO): today 20 walking, 20 on the metro or RER, 17.5 waiting; inside one station 5 walking and 7.5 waiting. The split of today's walking between the two stations is for illustration. The script rescales these so that each row adds up to the model's figure.

waiting on the platform at Nord-Est

platform_cases.label: Stops and goes on
platform_cases.note: A TGV stop takes 3 minutes, 4 to 5 at the largest hubs. This study counts {stop}.

platform_cases.label: Reverses, a driver at each end
platform_cases.note: This study allows {reverse} minutes to change direction at Nord-Est, plus one minute for the train to clear the platform. French practice is 10 to 12 minutes, or about 3 with a second driver waiting.

platform_cases.label: Turns round at a terminal
platform_cases.note: A planning figure of the track owner (then Réseau ferré de France, now SNCF Réseau) for a train reversing at a platform of the Roissy airport station: 20 minutes, called comfortable, with about 10 more kept as a margin.

platform_cases.label: Quickest low-cost turn-round
platform_cases.note: The shortest turn-round in the timetable of the low-cost TGV service, which is built on quick turn-rounds: 26 minutes.
